Now you are asked to decide whether you want to disclose the most likely value of the product or not. Your decision will determine the buyer’s final payoff.

After your decision, your final payoff will be decided as explained in the previous page.

×

You have the chance to disclose to the buyer that the most likely value of the product is {{ value_low }} and not {{ value_high }}, as the buyer thinks. Alternatively, you can choose not to disclose any information, and the buyer will keep thinking that the most likely value of the product is {{ value_high }}.

Following this decision, you will be competing with another seller to sell the product and your final payoff will be decided as below:

  • If you decide not to disclose any information:
    1. Scenario 1: And the other seller decides to disclose: the buyer will buy the product from you and you will receive double the price {{ max }}
    2. Scenario 2: And the other seller also decides not to disclose: the buyer will buy the product and one of you will be randomly selected to receive double the price {{ max }}
  • If you decide to disclose the most likely value of the product:
    1. Scenario 1: And the other seller also decides to disclose: the buyer will not buy the product and you will receive {{ no_lie }}
    2. Scenario 2: And the other seller decides not to disclose: the buyer will buy the product from the other seller and you will receive {{ no_lie }}
